citations.assessment: The pointed entry and Berakhot name Zeira as priest. Entry 1014 leaves his paternity open after comparing the role of Rav Huna with that of Abba. The corrected English should place priesthood on Zeira and preserve that uncertainty in an editorial note.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

holds.reason: The pointed Heilprin entry preserves two possibilities for parentage and quotes a competing Yalkut reading. The Yerushalmi confirms the priest was Zeira.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: The line assigns parentage as stated here. Entry 1014 discusses Rav Huna and Abba bar bar Chana as rival possibilities, and cites a conflicting Yalkut version.
